prompts.werewolf:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ONE original illustration for the coordinated Moonlight fantasy game-card collection, revised art direction V2. Portrait 2:3, 1024x1536.
SHARED COLLECTION TEMPLATE (strict):
Elegant dark fantasy storybook painting with subtle tarot-card composition. Simplified gouache painting, broad matte color planes, soft dry-brush texture visible only gently. Stylized illustrative anatomy, NOT photorealistic, NOT a detailed digital fantasy painting, NOT 3D, NOT anime. Restrained medium-low detail: large readable shapes and a strong graphic silhouette; no tiny surface decoration or dense textures. Keep visually clear at 180px card width.
Framing: one centered, straight-on waist-up character. Character occupies the central 68% of the card width. Top of head/ears/hat at 17% from top, eye line about 31%, waist at 87%; preserve clear space to border. Foreground prop when present centered at lower chest, large and simple. No diagonal pose, no off-center character, no full body.
Lighting: soft cool silver moonlight from upper left, gentle shadows toward lower right; restrained luminous accent only from the signature prop. Palette: midnight blue #101827 background, deep indigo #20263b clothing, muted lavender #a89aba shadows, silver-gray #cbd0dc highlights; warm gold #d5aa58 only where required. Quiet elegant mystery.
Background: smooth minimal midnight-blue field with a very soft blue moonlit gradient behind the head; no forest, buildings, scenery, stars, floating decorations, or busy sky.
Border: identical thin continuous silver rectangular frame inset 4% from all four edges, subtly rounded corners, uniform simple 2px line at full resolution. NO ornament, additional frame lines, flourishes, lettering, title, numbering, logos, watermark or text of any kind. This illustration is the full card.
Costume: plain shapes and minimal folds. No elaborate embroidery, jewelry, necklaces, belts with accessories, or decorative objects.
Keep original, professionally art-directed, quiet and iconic. CHARACTER: WEREWOLF — THE HUNTER. A powerful silver-gray anthropomorphic wolf with broad shoulders and a commanding centered silhouette, front facing, waist-up. Simplify the fur into a few broad painted tufts instead of individual hairs. Pale subtly luminous eyes, closed mouth, alert secretive expression, no snarling or gore. Plain midnight-blue cloak without clasp, jewelry or decoration. A single partially eclipsed pale silver moon directly behind its head, a simple clean disk rather than intricate lunar craters. The eclipsed moon is the unmistakable signature motif. Hands rest unobtrusively near the waist; no weapon, no other prop. Emphasize secrecy, danger and nighttime hunting through silhouette and soft shadow.
